label: vBucket checkpoint
type: an internal per-vBucket data structure the KV engine uses to batch mutations for replication/persistence, hasInternalComponent of server:vbucket. Configurable via cbepctl set checkpoint_param; monitored via cbstats checkpoint.
evidence: This command changes checkpoint configuration parameters.
The checkpoint command, used by cbstats, provides information on the checkpoint data structure for a specified bucket, on a specified node.
relates_to_competency_question: What internal structure batches mutations for a vBucket, and how is its memory allocation bounded?
